summary: In August 2026 Fly, a South Korean delivery agency platform, found unauthorized access through abnormal access routes that exposed data on administrators, delivery riders, stores and ordering customers. Leaked data included names, contact details, addresses and bank account information, resident registration numbers for administrators and riders, business registration numbers for stores, and some building entrance codes for customers. Fly blocked the access routes and reported to KISA, the Personal Information Protection Commission and police.
